blurb: Bloedel Donovan Park offers various amenities such as barbecue grills, boat and stand-up paddleboard rentals, a boat launch, dog off-leash area, multipurpose fields, outdoor basketball and volleyball courts, picnic tables, playground, restrooms, and trails. The park is open daily from 6:00 a.m. to 10 p.m. There are two community buildings available for reservation.
